title: Gas Station
statement:
Gas stations stand in a circle along a road. Station `i` has `gas[i]` units of fuel, and driving from station `i` to the next one burns `cost[i]` units. After the last station the road comes back to station 0. Your car starts with an empty tank, and you take all the fuel at every station you reach. Find the station where you can start and drive all the way around, back to that station.

The first line is the number of stations `n`, at least 1. The second line has the `n` gas amounts and the third line the `n` costs, whole numbers of 0 or more separated by spaces. Your tank may be empty when you reach a station, but it can never run out on the road. Print the index of the starting station, counting from 0, or `-1` when no start gets all the way around. When some start works, it is the only one.

Input:

```text
5
1 2 3 4 5
3 4 5 1 2
```

Expected output:

```text
3
```

Starting at station 3 with 4 units, you reach station 4 with 3 left, then station 0 with 6, station 1 with 4, station 2 with 2, and station 3 again with 0.
hints: If all the gas adds up to less than all the costs, no start can work. Otherwise one does.
Drive from station 0 and keep a running tank of gas minus cost. When the tank drops below 0 after station `i`, no station from your start up to `i` can be the start either.
So start over from station `i + 1` with an empty tank, without going back to try the stations you passed.

python.solution:
def find_start_station(gas: list[int], cost: list[int]) -> int:
    total = 0  # fuel left after the whole circle
    tank = 0  # fuel left since the current start
    start = 0
    for i in range(len(gas)):
        total += gas[i] - cost[i]
        tank += gas[i] - cost[i]
        if tank < 0:
            # No station from start to i can be the start, so try the next one.
            start = i + 1
            tank = 0
    return start if total >= 0 else -1


n = int(input())
gas = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
cost = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
print(find_start_station(gas, cost))
